D: Two slackers invent a backyard game that becomes a pro league, then fight to keep it pure.
P: Serve the snacks when the Milwaukee Beers take the court.
S: Cheese curds fried in a crisp golden beer batter

Squeaky cheese curds (or bocconcini) in a light beer batter, fried until puffed and golden, with a garlicky buttermilk ranch for dipping. Pat 400g cheese curds or halved cherry bocconcini dry and freeze 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, half a tsp garlic powder, 1 egg and 200ml cold lager into a smooth batter. Dust the cheese in flour, dip in batter and fry in batches at 185C for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. For ranch, mix 100g sour cream, 60ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayo, chives, dill and garlic.
Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese
Soft pretzel bites with a warm lager cheddar sauce

Chewy pretzel bites dipped in a bicarb bath, salted and baked deep brown, with a hot cheddar and lager cheese sauce for dunking. Heat the oven to 220C. Roll 500g pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Simmer 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds. Drain, place on lined trays, brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 150ml milk and 100ml lager, then 200g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard until smooth.
M: Grilled bratwurst in rolls with beer onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard

Bratwurst simmered in lager with onions, then charred on the grill and stuffed into toasted rolls with the beer onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard. Put 8 bratwurst in a wide pan with 2 sliced onions, 2 x 375ml cans of lager and 20g butter. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Lift out the sausages and grill on a hot barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes until charred. Boil the onions in the beer until most of it evaporates and they're sticky. Toast 8 long rolls and fill with a bratwurst, onions, warmed sauerkraut (300g) and hot mustard.
W: Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, salted peanuts and crushed pretzels

Vanilla ice cream under homemade hot fudge sauce, salted peanuts, whipped cream and a cherry, with crushed pretzels for a salty crunch. Heat 150ml cream, 100g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp golden syrup and 20g butter in a saucepan, stirring until smooth and glossy, about 3 minutes. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over the warm fudge sauce. Top each with salted peanuts (60g total), crushed pretzels (40g total), a swirl of whipped cream (150ml) and a maraschino cherry.
K: Brandy muddled with orange, cherry, sugar and bitters

Brandy muddled with orange, sugar, bitters and a cherry the Wisconsin way, topped with lemon-lime soda over ice. In each of 4 rocks glasses, muddle 1 orange slice, 1 maraschino cherry, 1 tsp sugar and 3 dashes of aromatic bitters until the sugar dissolves. Fill with ice, add 50ml brandy and top with 60ml lemon-lime soda. Stir gently and garnish with another cherry and an orange slice. For non-drinkers, swap the brandy for cold black tea.
